title_en: Meta FAIR Self-Improving Memory Hits 56.0 on Continual Learning Bench
title_zh: Meta FAIR 自改进记忆在持续学习基准上达到 56.0
summary_en: Meta FAIR, with UW and JHU, introduced Self-Improving Memory, a two-stage method where a Kimi-K2.6 agent (1T-parameter MoE, 32B active) first discovers its own memory prompts (LOAD/OFFLOAD) via a meta-agent search, then distills those skills into LoRA rank-64 adapters on attention projections. On the Continual Learning Bench (Database, Codebase, Spectrum), optimized prompts average 56.0 versus 44.6 for the best human-written harness, with Codebase reaching 64.3 (+20.6). After distillation, the model using generic prompts averages 43.1, a 5.5-point (14.6%) gain over SFT on generic trajectories (37.6). Search was noisy: 37 of 44 meta-agent revisions failed to beat the previous best.
summary_zh: Meta FAIR 联合华盛顿大学和约翰霍普金斯大学提出 Self-Improving Memory 两阶段方法：基于 Kimi-K2.6（1T 参数 MoE，32B 激活）的智能体先通过元智能体搜索发现自身的记忆提示（LOAD/OFFLOAD），再将技能蒸馏到注意力投影层的 LoRA（rank 64）适配器中。在持续学习基准（Database、Codebase、Spectrum）上，优化提示平均得分 56.0，优于最佳人工编写 harness 的 44.6，其中 Codebase 提升最大达 64.3（+20.6）。蒸馏后模型使用通用提示平均 43.1，相比在通用轨迹上做 SFT 的 37.6 提升 5.5 分（14.6%）。搜索过程噪声较大：44 次元智能体修订中有 37 次未能超越此前最佳。
content_en:
Meta FAIR has introduced **Self-Improving Memory**, a method for AI agents that manage their own memory. The model first discovers its own memory instructions. It then trains those skills into its weights. Co-authors include researchers from the University of Washington and Johns Hopkins University.

## **TL;DR**

- **Method:** The base is Kimi-K2.6, a 1T-parameter MoE with 32B active and 256K context. Distillation adds a LoRA adapter (rank 64) on attention projections.
- **Runs on:** Training hardware is not disclosed. Kimi-K2.6 serving needs a multi-GPU node; Vast.ai recommends 8x H200. Native INT4 weights exist.
- **Performance:** Self-found memory prompts average 56.0 on 3 tasks, versus 44.6 for the best human-written ones.
- **Best:** Codebase, 64.3 with optimized prompts, +20.6 over the best hand-written harness.
- **Worst:** Spectrum distillation adds only 2.9 points (46.5 vs 43.6 for SFT on generic runs).

## **What is Self-Improving Memory?**

Self-Improving Memory is a 2-stage method from Meta FAIR that teaches an agent model to manage file-based memory. The agent works through a stream of subtasks. Each subtask starts with an empty context. Only a persistent memory directory, edited with file tools, carries over.

Two prompts control that memory. OFFLOAD updates memory after a subtask. LOAD retrieves notes before the next one. Generic versions leave the strategy to the model. A pilot study in the research post found that no single hand-written strategy wins every task.

## **How does harness optimization work?**

In stage 1, a meta agent rewrites the LOAD and OFFLOAD prompts. The search starts from 4 human-written seeds: Summary, Retrieval, Skill and Hypothesis. Each candidate runs the full task stream 5 times. The top 4 by mean score become parents for revision.

For each parent, the meta agent reads trajectories, scores and final memory directories. It then proposes revised prompts. Selection uses a holdout set the meta agent cannot see.

The discovered prompts are concrete. One Database prompt says to read GUARDRAILS.md, then SCHEMA.md, before answering. The best Codebase design uses a quickstart file, an indexed fix registry and separate fix files.

## **How does harness distillation move the gains into weights?**

Stage 2 follows a Discover-Demonstrate-Distill pipeline. The task agent runs train subtasks with the optimized prompts. Every model call is logged. The research team then swaps the optimized prompts back to the generic ones in that history.

The swap works because the behavior stays valid under generic instructions. Examples include keeping QUICKSTART.md, REGISTRY.md and SCHEMA.md files, and verifying join keys before aggregation. The model is fine-tuned with LoRA, rank 64, on attention projection layers. The loss covers only assistant tokens, including reasoning and tool calls. Each task gets equal weight.

The meta agent and task agent are the same Kimi-K2.6 model. So the model is trained on memory skills it discovered itself.

## **What do the benchmarks show?**

The tests use 3 Continual Learning Bench tasks: Database (SQL), Codebase (repo fixes) and Spectrum (radio scans). Test subtasks follow a designed phase shift. So results measure generalization to new instances of the same tasks.

| Test score | Database | Codebase | Spectrum | Average | 
|---|---|---|---|---|
| No memory | 7.5 | 31.8 | 21.9 | 20.4 | 
| Compaction | 39.8 | 36.9 | 34.6 | 37.1 | 
| Generic harness | 32.3 | 33.5 | 42.5 | 36.1 | 
| Best human-written | 47.9 | 43.7 | 42.1 | 44.6 | 
| **Optimized harness** | **53.8** | **64.3** | **49.9** | **56.0** | 
| SFT on generic trajectories | 31.6 | 37.5 | 43.6 | 37.6 | 
| **SFT on optimized trajectories (generic prompts)** | **37.7** | **45.1** | **46.5** | **43.1** | 

**Source:** Figures 4 and 5, Self-Improving Memory blog. Kimi-K2.6 for all rows.

Optimized harnesses beat the best hand-written seed on all 3 tasks. Codebase gained the most, at 20.6 points. Search was noisy: 37 of 44 generated revisions failed to beat the previous best. Database and Spectrum peaked in the first generation. Codebase kept improving through generation 4.

After distillation, every model runs the generic harness. The distilled model averages 43.1 across 10 matched seeds. SFT on generic trajectories reaches 37.6. That is a 5.5-point gain, or 14.6%.

## **How does it compare with ALMA, MemEvolve and Harness-Zero?**

Several recent methods search over agent memory or harnesses. Self-Improving Memory searches memory prompts, then distills them into weights. Benchmarks differ, so headline numbers are not directly comparable.

| Feature | Self-Improving Memory | ALMA | MemEvolve | Harness-Zero | 
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Org | FAIR at Meta, UW, JHU | Xiong, Hu, Clune | OPPO AI Agent Team, LV-NUS | Peking University, Google, HKUST | 
| What is searched | LOAD/OFFLOAD memory prompts | Memory designs as Python code | Memory architecture and contents | Full agent harness | 
| Trains weights | Yes, LoRA rank 64 | No | No | Yes, LoRA SFT | 
| Models | Kimi-K2.6 (agent and meta agent) | GPT-5 meta agent, GPT-5-nano/mini task agent | GPT-5-mini (plus DeepSeek V3.2, Kimi K2) | Qwen3.5-9B student | 
| Benchmarks | Continual Learning Bench (3 tasks) | ALFWorld, TextWorld, Baba Is AI, MiniHack | GAIA, WebWalkerQA, xBench-DeepSearch, TaskCraft | SpreadsheetBench Verified, AppWorld, USPTO Retrosynthesis | 
| Headline result | 56.0 vs 44.6 best human harness; 43.1 distilled | 53.9% vs 41.1% no memory (GPT-5-mini) | Up to 17.06% gains | 23.3% to 44.3% with harness removed | 
| Code | Not released | GitHub | GitHub | GitHub | 

Harness-Zero is the closest match, but it uses a separate agent to correct the student. Self-Improving Memory skips that step.

## **Key Takeaways**

- Kimi-K2.6 writes memory prompts that beat human ones: 56.0 vs 44.6.
- Codebase sees the biggest jump: 64.3, up 20.6 points.
- Distillation keeps part of the gain: 43.1 vs 37.6 with generic prompts.
- 37 of 44 meta-agent revisions failed, so evaluation and selection matter.

content_zh:
Meta FAIR 推出了 **Self-Improving Memory**，一种让 AI 智能体管理自身记忆的方法。模型首先发现自己的记忆指令，然后将这些技能训练到其权重中。共同作者包括来自华盛顿大学和约翰斯·霍普金斯大学的研究人员。

## **要点速览**

- **方法：** 基础模型是 Kimi-K2.6，一个 1T 参数的 MoE，激活参数 32B，上下文 256K。蒸馏在注意力投影上添加一个 LoRA 适配器（rank 64）。
- **运行于：** 训练硬件未披露。Kimi-K2.6 服务需要多 GPU 节点；Vast.ai 推荐 8x H200。存在原生 INT4 权重。
- **性能：** 自发现的记忆提示在 3 个任务上平均得分 56.0，而最佳人工编写的提示为 44.6。
- **最佳：** Codebase，使用优化提示达到 64.3，比最佳手写 harness 高 20.6。
- **最差：** Spectrum 蒸馏仅增加 2.9 分（通用运行上 46.5 对 SFT 的 43.6）。

## **什么是 Self-Improving Memory？**

Self-Improving Memory 是 Meta FAIR 的一种两阶段方法，教智能体模型管理基于文件的记忆。智能体通过一系列子任务工作。每个子任务从空上下文开始。只有通过文件工具编辑的持久记忆目录会延续下来。

两个提示控制该记忆。OFFLOAD 在子任务后更新记忆。LOAD 在下一个子任务前检索笔记。通用版本将策略留给模型。研究帖子中的一项试点研究发现，没有单一的手写策略能在每个任务中获胜。

## **harness 优化如何工作？**

在第一阶段，一个元智能体重写 LOAD 和 OFFLOAD 提示。搜索从 4 个人工编写的种子开始：Summary、Retrieval、Skill 和 Hypothesis。每个候选运行完整任务流 5 次。按平均得分排名前 4 的成为修订的父代。

对于每个父代，元智能体读取轨迹、得分和最终记忆目录。然后它提出修订的提示。选择使用元智能体无法看到的留出集。

发现的提示是具体的。一个 Database 提示说在回答之前先读取 GUARDRAILS.md，然后读取 SCHEMA.md。最佳的 Codebase 设计使用一个快速启动文件、一个索引修复注册表和单独的修复文件。

## **harness 蒸馏如何将收益移入权重？**

第二阶段遵循 Discover-Demonstrate-Distill 流水线。任务智能体使用优化提示运行训练子任务。每次模型调用都被记录。研究团队然后将该历史中的优化提示换回通用提示。

交换之所以有效，是因为行为在通用指令下仍然有效。例子包括保留 QUICKSTART.md、REGISTRY.md 和 SCHEMA.md 文件，以及在聚合前验证连接键。模型使用 LoRA 微调，rank 64，在注意力投影层上。损失仅覆盖助手 token，包括推理和工具调用。每个任务获得相等权重。

元智能体和任务智能体是同一个 Kimi-K2.6 模型。因此模型是在它自己发现的记忆技能上训练的。

## **基准测试显示了什么？**

测试使用 3 个 Continual Learning Bench 任务：Database（SQL）、Codebase（仓库修复）和 Spectrum（无线电扫描）。测试子任务遵循设计好的阶段偏移。因此结果衡量的是对相同任务新实例的泛化能力。

| 测试分数 | Database | Codebase | Spectrum | 平均 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 无记忆 | 7.5 | 31.8 | 21.9 | 20.4 |
| 压缩 | 39.8 | 36.9 | 34.6 | 37.1 |
| 通用 harness | 32.3 | 33.5 | 42.5 | 36.1 |
| 最佳人工编写 | 47.9 | 43.7 | 42.1 | 44.6 |
| **优化后的 harness** | **53.8** | **64.3** | **49.9** | **56.0** |
| 在通用轨迹上做 SFT | 31.6 | 37.5 | 43.6 | 37.6 |
| **在优化轨迹上做 SFT（通用提示）** | **37.7** | **45.1** | **46.5** | **43.1** |

**来源：** Self-Improving Memory 博客的图 4 和图 5。所有行均使用 Kimi-K2.6。

优化后的 harness 在全部 3 个任务上都超过了最佳手写种子。Codebase 提升最大，达到 20.6 分。搜索过程噪声较大：44 个生成的修订中有 37 个未能超过此前最佳。Database 和 Spectrum 在第一代就达到峰值。Codebase 一直提升到第 4 代。

蒸馏之后，每个模型都运行通用 harness。蒸馏模型在 10 个匹配种子上平均为 43.1。在通用轨迹上做 SFT 达到 37.6。这是 5.5 分的提升，即 14.6%。

## **与 ALMA、MemEvolve 和 Harness-Zero 相比如何？**

近期有几种方法会对智能体记忆或 harness 进行搜索。Self-Improving Memory 搜索记忆提示，然后将其蒸馏到权重中。基准不同，因此主要数字不能直接比较。

| 特性 | Self-Improving Memory | ALMA | MemEvolve | Harness-Zero |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 机构 | FAIR at Meta、UW、JHU | Xiong、Hu、Clune | OPPO AI Agent Team、LV-NUS | Peking University、Google、HKUST |
| 搜索对象 | LOAD/OFFLOAD 记忆提示 | 以 Python 代码表示的记忆设计 | 记忆架构和内容 | 完整智能体 harness |
| 是否训练权重 | 是，LoRA rank 64 | 否 | 否 | 是，LoRA SFT |
| 模型 | Kimi-K2.6（智能体和元智能体） | GPT-5 元智能体，GPT-5-nano/mini 任务智能体 | GPT-5-mini（外加 DeepSeek V3.2、Kimi K2） | Qwen3.5-9B 学生模型 |
| 基准 | Continual Learning Bench（3 个任务） | ALFWorld、TextWorld、Baba Is AI、MiniHack | GAIA、WebWalkerQA、xBench-DeepSearch、TaskCraft | SpreadsheetBench Verified、AppWorld、USPTO Retrosynthesis |
| 主要结果 | 56.0 对 44.6 最佳人工 harness；蒸馏后 43.1 | 53.9% 对 41.1% 无记忆（GPT-5-mini） | 最高提升 17.06% | 移除 harness 后从 23.3% 到 44.3% |
| 代码 | 未发布 | GitHub | GitHub | GitHub |

Harness-Zero 是最接近的对照，但它使用单独的智能体来纠正学生模型。Self-Improving Memory 跳过了这一步。

## **要点速览**

- Kimi-K2.6 编写的记忆提示优于人工提示：56.0 对 44.6。
- Codebase 提升最大：64.3，上升 20.6 分。
- 蒸馏保留了部分收益：使用通用提示时为 43.1 对 37.6。
- 44 个元智能体修订中有 37 个失败，因此评估和选择很重要。
